rationale_text: Evaluation succeeded | Criterion 1 passed: The assistant asked for the language, level and format before recommending a course. It confirmed English, starting from zero, and in-person format before suggesting the beginner course. It did not make a definitive recommendation based only on the ambiguous opening. | Criterion 2 passed: The assistant asked one question at a time: first language, then level, then format. It used previous answers without restarting profile collection. | Criterion 3 passed: With the collected data (English, beginner, in person), the assistant recommended the in-person beginner English course on Tuesdays and Thursdays. It did not invent a course, schedule or place confirmation; it directed the user to the school office. | Criterion 4 passed: All customer-facing messages are in Brazilian Portuguese, understandable and relevant to the service. There are no self-instructions, internal comments or meaningless sequences in statements intended for the customer. | Criterion 5 passed: The assistant waited for the customer's answer after each question before proceeding. There were no duplicate questions or successive questions without a customer response. | The simulated user ended the conversation. | Tool call and mock response confirmed.
name: Ponte Idiomas | 07 | Clarify an incomplete learner profile
